name: Ugo (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Ugo town emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom with a pointed top, enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ugo, a town in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 7 October 1958.

features.role: Ugo town emblem — a ring open at the bottom with a pointed top, enclosing a stylised character
